I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the site is **Gate 47**.

On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23 in #central-team, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because she'd read the wrong line. I read the channel after her correction and nothing has changed it since.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, so I only used messages they can already see. A search of the knowledge brain turned up nothing about the inbound lane site, so the answer comes from the channel messages alone.
